title: Disk transfer representations and confined bridge mass
main_claim: Critical honeycomb strip bridges of width R: B_C(R) ≍ B(R) ≍ R^{-1/4}, and M_C(R), M(R) = R^{13/12+o(1)}, so the mean length is R^{4/3+o(1)} both unrestricted and inside a fixed corridor CR. The paper also proves an arch kernel h(m) ≍ m^{-5/4}, height and diameter tails R^{-1/4}, an arch mean length H^{4/3+o(1)}, and a triangle bulk visit probability R^{-2/3+o(1)}.

issues.location: analytic.tex Secs 4-5 (disk-vector interpolation compatibility; contour stability, coercivity and complex-period continuation)
issues.description: Two parts are too compressed to referee line by line: the hyperplane-compatibility induction for the polynomial disk vector (chain and reverse-chain cases), and the stability and coercivity estimates behind the uniform contour bound (Theorem c2:thm-contour-bound). The explicit constants that feed the final exponent do check: A_inf, c_s, the M_± factorizations, J/M_+ and the harmonic exponent h(π/2)=0. I found no specific wrong step; these parts are simply unverified.
issues.evidence: Theorem c2:thm-contour-bound and Prop c2:prop-disk-vector rest on long chains of terse arguments (e.g. 'Coefficients ... follow by multiplication', the 'reverse-chain compatibility' paragraph). Sibling audits in family 237 flagged the same kind of analytic core as unverifiable line by line.

coverage:
Read the whole paper; analytic Sec 5 (stability) only skimmed. Checked numerically or symbolically:
- **Local weights:** A/T=x, B/T=C/T=D/T=x^2 and E=0 at u=λ.
- **Exploration and wedges:** the exploration phase bound c·Σh ≤ 1, c e^{iS}=1−q^{-1}, wedge constants c_α (0.414 < 0.707 < 1) and their derivation from the imaginary-part identity, and the monotone-kernel identity (2πs+θ=π, sin(πs+θ)=sin πs).
- **Boundary deficit:** Meixner–Pollaczek evaluation at v=3i/8, with coefficients of (1−y)^{-7/8}(1+y)^{-1/8} matching |p_m| and of order m^{-1/8}, giving a squared norm ~N^{3/4} and a deficit ~N^{-1/4}. Also the G/J accretive comparison (Re(I+iA)^{-1}=(I+A^2)^{-1}).
- **Tails:** lost-arc tail logic, upper/lower tail bootstraps (L_- ≤ M ≤ L_+, H/√3 ≤ L_+ + max z), strip identity B(T)=c μ_+(H>T).
- **Determinant normalization:** the kernel identity (H+11^t) gauged equals k1 (numerical); k0=(2/3)sec(4u/3); pair limit 4(2+d)^2/9; contour shift of w1 by i/3 (moments match); S(t) accretive (|arg S| ≤ 0.28 < π/6); ∫log|S| coefficient = 5/24 to 1e-20.
- **Base cancellation:** P^2/((2+d)^{2n(n-1)}4^{n^2}) has base 4(2+d)^2/81, matching A_inf = Σc_j log sin(πj/24) (c_j list, Σc_j = Σjc_j = 0, and −2∫H da/a all verified).
- **Contour constants:** M_± factorizations; c_s=9/8 and M_-~1/(2a); J/M_+ = sinh a/cosh(3a/2); H(a) rational form.
- **Saturation:** h(θ)=1/6−2Re θ^2/(3π^2) with h(π/2)=0, and the saturation lemma's barrier argument.
- **Polygon and winding bounds:** vacancy-identity coefficient table (a*=σ > b* > 0); B3 derivation; F ≲ R^{-3} exponent bookkeeping; polygon shape L^{-2}; cylinder contractible O(N/L); winding-separator matrix argument (the top-exit real part equals exactly x; (I−A)S identity; ρ ≥ t0·W0).
- **Visits and nesting:** visit recursion signs and constants (c1, c2, ±8π/3 → −1); nesting localization V ≍ Z_{cn}^2 giving z=1/12.
- **Exponent assembly:** triangle law (R^{-2/3}, R^{4/3}); arch first/second moments R^{3+z−p}, R^{5+z−2p} giving R^{1+z}; tube Cauchy–Schwarz exponent −1−p; bend sewing exponents; two-arm first/second moments R^{3+z−2p}, R^{6+z−4p} giving R^z per vertex; final assembly R^{2+z}/R = R^{13/12}; corridor independent of ε.
sibling_notes: Family 237 siblings (Polynomial-vacuum, Cylinder-loop-weights, Signed-cylinder, etc.) report the same constants: the 5/24 Pfaffian denominator, the 3/8 interval exponent, saturation at fugacity zero, and the R^{13/12} first moment. This paper restates the visit recursion of PolynomialVacuumCompanion Prop 8.1 and proves it independently. It does not rely on that paper's corridor result, so there is no circular dependence. Its posted board entry is consistent with theirs.
